name: Machu Picchu Mountain
why: Higher and quieter than Huayna Picchu: the citadel, Huayna Picchu and the Urubamba loop seen from 3,082 m.
book: A Machu Picchu ticket that includes the Mountain (limited per time slot).
dangers: An hour and a half of Inca steps up; hard on the knees down.
turnaround: Respect the time on your ticket.

points.name: Machu Picchu
points.note: Enter the citadel and follow the signs to the Mountain control.

points.name: Machu Picchu Mountain
points.note: 3,082 m: the citadel and Huayna Picchu far below.
